method.permutation_convention: c(v,x,y)=alpha^x beta^y(motif_colors[v]); permutations act on literal colors 0,1,2,3
method.equivariant_scope: All 120 ordered commuting pairs in S4 squared; no color symmetry breaking. UNSAT for all pairs would exclude only colorings equivariant under every unit translation of the supplied geometric lattice, not arbitrary larger periods.
method.group_bound: The image is an abelian subgroup of S4, hence has order 1,2,3 or4. Every source has a triangle, so >=3 used colors make the action faithful. Literal translation subgroup equals the permutation kernel.
method.hnf_convention: Columns (a,0),(b,d), a,d>0 and 0<=b<a. Representatives (x,y),0<=x<a,0<=y<d. Reduce y=q*d+r, then x to (x-q*b) mod a. Every finite-index subgroup of Z squared has exactly one such basis.
method.minimality_scope: A found minimum excludes all smaller finite-index subgroups of the supplied geometric lattice, including skew ones. The supplied geometric cell is not asserted primitive; periods using additional geometric symmetries are not classified.
method.evidence_scope: SAT assignments are independently checked on lifted source edges and triangles. UNSAT results are solver decisions without archived formal unsatisfiability certificates. No four-color theorem is assumed and no Lean theorem is added.

K5.expected: All 120 equivariant pairs and all 15 HNF quotients UNSAT
